containerPolicy.NPNF: NPNF volumes remain edition/container records. Individual works inside them are canonical Works and inherit edition, translator, page-scan and provenance relations without treating the container as a book identity.

visualPolicy: Where CCEL page scans exist, use authentic title-page/page-scan imagery for browse enrichment before generated covers. PRDL-linked historical editions may supply edition-specific title pages after rights/source resolution.
